definitions.explanation: The act of putting a law, regulation, or policy into effect. Commonly used in legal and governmental contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{施行|しこう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This law will be enforced starting next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{施行|しこう}⟦{日|び}→日：12732_nichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The enforcement date for the new regulation has been decided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{施行|しこう}⟦により→による：28349_niyoru⟧、⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}された→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧。
examples.english: Smoking was banned through the enforcement of the ordinance.

notes:
READING NOTE:
In legal contexts, this word is read しこう. However, a related word ⟦{施工|せこう}→施工：06618_sekou⟧ (construction work) exists with a different reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{施行|しこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to enforce, to implement)
・{施行|しこう}⟦{日|び}→日：12732_nichi⟧ (enforcement date)
・{施行|しこう}⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧ (enforcement regulations)
・⟦{即日|そくじつ}→即日：09661_sokujitsu⟧{施行|しこう} (immediate enforcement)

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{公布|こうふ}→公布：08394_koufu⟧ (promulgation) - announcing a law
・{施行|しこう} (enforcement) - putting a law into effect
・⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧ (abolition) - ending a law
